title: E1ClauseV3C in the tree: the three-term clause is a named data hole with a closed-form t^2 coefficient
body: Part D of formal/RhAttack/E1Clause.lean adds the 0153 law as a NAMED CLAUSE. New objects: T_MEAS3 = 9e18 (tMeas3Pos, gLastLtTMeas3); defect_A3 = -25254354, defect_B3 = 523472285 (the 33-row face pins); defect_L3 = ln(U_TOP/(2 pi)) + 1 and defect_C3 = -defect_L3/(2 pi * U_TOP) -- the t^2 coefficient IN CLOSED FORM at the in-tree truncation U = U_TOP = 10^30 (defect_L3_pos, defect_L3_le_271, defect_C3neg); M_defect3 t = A3 ln t + B3 + C3 t^2; defect_C3absT3 : |C3| * T_MEAS3 <= 2439/10^12 (the t^2 piece of the wire budget, all constants); mdefect3_bounded : |M_defect3 t| <= 2.3e26 on (G_LAST, T_MEAS3] (three-term triangle + |C3| bound + the t^3-free tail estimate); E1ClauseV3C q B := the three-term version of E1ClauseV3 on (G_LAST, T_MEAS3]; e1V3C_implies_abs; if_E1V3C_and_walk (same Qside contract as the V3 twin). BUILD: RhAttack.E1Clause green, FULL TREE GREEN (17450 jobs). WIRING STATE: V3 (q 7000 on (G, 1000 G]) and V3C (q 10000 on (G, 9e18]) are now two COEXISTING named holes above G; the terminal face is NOT rewired (S1Uniform.201 still consumes V3) -- rewiring is a budget decision (V3C's B = 10000 vs V3's B = 7000) to be made at the endpoint face-shaping step, not unilaterally. PRECISION NOTES (lean 4.33.1 + mathlib pin): (i) linarith fails when (10:R)^30 is a COEFFICIENT of an atom but works when it is the ATOM; (ii) norm_num CANNOT decide product inequalities of 10^18-scale real terms -- it leaves `False` as an unsolved goal, which is how it caught a 4-order-of-magnitude bound bug (2.3e23 vs the required 2.3e26); split such tails into small norm_num facts + nlinarith; (iii) field_simp inside a calc justification needs its own `have` (calc justifications do not parse tac blocks the way has-blocks do in this context); (iv) add_le_add on field types unifies addends ambiguously -- close with nlinarith or explicit shape lemmas. No RH claim: V3C is a data clause exactly like V3; the closed-form C3 is a model-level identity about I_far's U-top truncation, not a theorem about zeta.
